Intel (INTC) vs Microsoft (MSFT): on the same formula, their operating margins are 51.0 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — INTC: $52.9B · MSFT: $331.8B
• Revenue growth — INTC: −0.5% · MSFT: +17.8%
• Operating margin — INTC: −4.2% · MSFT: 46.8%
• Net margin — INTC: −0.5% · MSFT: 40.3%
• Free cash flow margin — INTC: −9.4% · MSFT: 20.2%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — INTC: −9.6% · MSFT: 13.7%

Different fiscal years: INTC Dec 27, 2025 · MSFT Jun 30, 2026. The periods are not identical.
